newsitem.title: UK: UK Nov oil output over 2.7 mpbd, revenues down - bank.
newsitem.headline: UK Nov oil output over 2.7 mpbd, revenues down - bank.

text.p: British oil production in November rose 58,000 barrels a day (bpd) on the month to hit 2.7 million bpd for the first since October 1995, the Royal Bank of Scotland said.
But oil revenues decreased from 11-year highs in October as lower international prices and the depreciation of the dollar against sterling outweighed the increase in output.
Revenues averaged 37.3 million pounds a day, down 7.2 per cent from 40.2 million October but still 8.7 million sterling, or 30 percent, higher than in November 1995.
Gas output rose sharply in November by 2.712 million cubic feet per day (cfd) to 10.336 million.
Gas revenues on provisional estimates climbed by almost 36 per cent on the month to 17.1 million sterling.
Oil and gas together boosted revenues in November by 3.4 percent from October to 54.4 million a day, up 21 per cent from a year ago.
